class.name: NNAngleToVector2SearchCriterion
class.brief_description: Filters and scores [Node2D] candidates by the signed angle between their facing direction and a 2D vector.
class.description: Compares each [Node2D] candidate's facing direction (+X rotated by global rotation) against [member angle_to_direction_vector] using a signed angle ([code]-180..180[/code] degrees). Use to filter or prefer 2D candidates facing within a specific angular arc (shaped optionally with [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.activation_curve]).

members.member: Reference 2D direction vector compared against each candidate's facing direction.
Maximum signed angle in degrees (up to [code]180.0[/code]). Maps to [code]1.0[/code] when scoring; angles above it are filtered out when filtering is enabled.
Minimum signed angle in degrees (down to [code]-180.0[/code]). Maps to [code]0.0[/code] when scoring; angles below it are filtered out when filtering is enabled.
